text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~...
It really does feel a bit tight after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...? The seat looks plenty spacious to me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I mean the bus itself.
I'm just really not good with cramped spaces like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I could just get off and run home, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about you too, Ruby?
The weather's great, so I'm sure it'll be fun.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...First of all, I doubt we'll get
permission to disembark.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Really? You might actually pull it off, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mr. C.B. went to ask
if they could stop the bus, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course not, permission denied!
Please return to your seat!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but look! It's such a perfect day for a walk,
wouldn't it be a waste not to go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As expected, it wasn't meant to be. ...And so,
this year's summer training camp drew to a close."
